items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: I knew, um, this Glover played piano.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the other people in Olle Powell's band?

Oh, let me see now. The only person I knew was Olle, and I knew, um, this Glover played piano. And, um, let's see, that's been way back in 1920. You kind of forget, you know, when they, when you, I can't think of anyone just now.
What about Tony Jackson? Did you ever know him around Chicago or here?
